# pdf-sign-linux

> Fill in and sign PDF documents on Linux with Adobe Reader XI under Wine, in
> an offline, rootless, SELinux confined podman container.
> Apache License 2.0. Author: Ivan Pinatti (https://github.com/ivan-pinatti).
> Canonical repository: https://github.com/ivan-pinatti-labs/pdf-sign-linux

## What it does

Runs the Windows Adobe Reader XI under Wine inside a podman container with no
network, for documents that other Linux PDF tools cannot handle, such as the
dynamic XFA forms on Canadian government sites. One command opens a document
in Reader to fill in, print (to a PDF in the project's inbox), sign with a
saved signature image, and save. Adobe Reader and Microsoft's core fonts are
downloaded by each user's local build and never shipped by this repository.

## Key files

- [README.md](README.md): Usage, folders, isolation model, legal notes
- [pdf-sign](pdf-sign): Launcher (build, open), container arguments
- [Makefile](Makefile): make build, make selinux, make open
- [containers/reader/Containerfile](containers/reader/Containerfile): The image: Wine, Reader, fonts, private Xwayland and CUPS
- [containers/reader/start-reader](containers/reader/start-reader): Entrypoint: print server, X server, Reader, clean shutdown
- [containers/reader/inbox-backend](containers/reader/inbox-backend): CUPS backend that saves print jobs as PDFs
- [selinux/generate.sh](selinux/generate.sh): Generates selinux/pdf_sign.cil (container_t plus Wayland) from the loaded policy
- [inbox/](inbox/README.md): Documents in and out; contents are never committed

## Tech stack

- Bash and POSIX sh, Python (policy generator), GNU Make
- Podman (rootless), Debian 13, Wine, Xwayland, matchbox, CUPS, Ghostscript, qpdf
- SELinux CIL policy module

## Conventions

- Conventional Commits for commit messages, no ticket prefix baked in
- pre-commit hooks wired up via
  [ivan-pinatti-labs/pre-commit-checklists](https://github.com/ivan-pinatti-labs/pre-commit-checklists),
